chunks: Abu Basir asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام about a voluntarily fasting person who is confronted by a need. He said:
He has the choice until the time of 'Asr. And if he remains until 'Asr, then it occurs to him to fast, and he had not intended that, then he may fast that day if he wishes.

key_terms.الْحَاجَةُ: a need or circumstance that arises
key_terms.الْمُتَطَوِّعِ: one performing a voluntary, non-obligatory act of fasting

ai.seo_question: Until what time can a person decide on a voluntary fast?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on voluntary fasting, stating that a person remains free to choose whether to continue or begin such a fast up to the time of 'Asr. It indicates flexibility in niyyah for a non-obligatory fast and highlights the ease of the law in recommended acts of worship.
